description: This file defines a Java interface 'AcknowledgementAdapterProvider' that provides methods to retrieve adapters for acknowledgements and acknowledgements collections used in the Ditto protocol.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAdapterProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that extends 'AdapterProvider' and provides methods to obtain adapters for acknowledgements.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for individual acknowledgements.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementsAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for collections of acknowledgements.
